screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.1: Sends the name and full tooltip of every registered item to the AI in the background, at the lowest priority. Items already in the cache are skipped.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.2: This uses your AI API quota and may cost money. Free tiers may hit 429 rate limits, and a 429 also pauses chat and tooltip translation for a while (warm-up pauses itself when rate limited).

screen.nyanlex.help.title: Help
screen.nyanlex.help.body:
Chat, boss bar, scoreboard, titles, action bar, name tags and books are translated automatically; the setting below controls whether you see the original text, both, or only the translation.

Items (tooltips, held item name, and container/hotbar item names) and custom-mod screen text follow whichever engine you pick for them: under AI fine translation they translate automatically, just like chat; under Machine translation (Google) they switch to manual translation instead, so joining a new server never floods it with translation requests -- anything already translated keeps showing automatically, but new text needs a key press. While on Machine translation, press R to translate (or re-translate) the item you are holding or pointing at. Press P to translate (or re-translate) the whole current screen. Press G to toggle between showing the original text and the translation.

Each surface (chat, items, scoreboard, name tags, boss bars, titles, action bar, books, screen text) has its own three-way mode: original only / original + translation / translation only.

Machine translation (Google) is fast and needs no setup. AI fine translation is higher quality, but needs an API key or a ChatGPT sign-in under "AI settings".

The request cooldown settings avoid sending too many translation requests in a short time, which could get you rate-limited.

The do-not-translate filter keeps the terms you list untranslated forever.

Export/Import lets you share your translated content with other players, or import a file someone else shared.

The master switch at the bottom turns off sending NEW translation requests entirely; anything already cached keeps showing normally.

The GitHub AI Translation Hub offers translations curated by the maintainers; they are fetched only when you press download, never automatically.

After joining a world or server, press "Identify Server/Mods & Download Translations" in GitHub AI Translation Hub Settings to download the curated translations.
